purpose: Verify the installed Genesis HDR overlay on one exact saved state before the bounded two-episode rerender measurement.
state_contract: Every rendered timestamp must have an exact row in trace_window.jsonl; do not interpolate states or advance physics. Use source/cache timestamps and images from the archived Direct-HDR evidence.

limits.write_scope: new run-id directory only; one frame only

claim_boundary: Offline exact-state renderer-cost replay, not a live closed-loop timing or causality test. Per-sample wall time and simulation-time availability are reported separately.
